notes: This is a fallback model used when no task-specific hand model exists.

Mining requires a pickaxe. Ensure a pickaxe is equipped or in inventory.
Rocks may have multiple interactable options.  'Mine' is the target option.
The player's Mining level must be sufficient to mine iron ore (level 21).
The player may need to walk to a nearby rock to mine.
